_comment: Applied to ChelseaKR/habitable on 2026-07-11 as repository ruleset 18815834. This committed export is the reviewable source of truth: v* tags cannot be updated or deleted, and new release tags must carry a valid signature (REL-07). Its empty bypass_actors list is the live state and is deliberate: nobody, owner included, may move a released tag. That is the opposite of main-branch.json, which records the owner's standing bypass for the same deliberate reason it exists there. Do not harmonise the two.
name: release tag protection (v*)
